name: condition
description: Free, reliable boolean test on the answer — numeric threshold, substring, or regex. No LLM call. Returns a bare true/false for flow decision nodes and external automation branching.
author: TDA Core Team

parameters.description: The rule to test: a numeric threshold (optionally with a first/last/max/min/sum selector), 'contains=TEXT', or a /regex/ pattern.

output_schema.description: true if the rule holds for the answer, false otherwise
